title: Integrated Multi-Omics Analysis Reveals Candidate Serum Biomarkers Linked to Cancer-Associated Fibroblast-Mediated Extracellular Matrix Remodeling in Metastatic Gastric Cancer.
snippet: Metastatic gastric cancer remains a major cause of cancer-related mortality, while currently available serum biomarkers have limited performance for metastatic risk assessment.
